text:
maria_dev: Quick question — we're shipping prompt telemetry to a central logging bucket for perf & QA. What's the least-privilege IAM setup for the service account that writes these logs? Right now it's got project-level logging.logWriter, but some folks suggested org-level so cross-project ingestion is simpler. Also, these logs may contain user prompts; we need to ensure PII is never stored in plaintext.

Aisha_security: short answer: avoid org-level roles. Prefer project-scoped writer + a redaction/encryption hop. If something needs cross-project access, do a controlled ingestion pipeline (Pub/Sub or a dedicated ingestion project) with explicit service accounts instead of giving org roles. For PII: redact or hash sensitive fields before write, or encrypt them with a KMS key that only the redaction service can decrypt.

josh_sre: +1. Project-level roles are easier to audit. If you must centralize logs, have the writer push to a central Pub/Sub topic in the ingestion project using a narrowly-scoped push SA, then the ingestion pipeline (with its own SA) does decryption/redaction and writes to the bucket. That keeps cross-project perms minimal.

maria_dev: That makes sense. For debugging we sometimes grant support temporary view access to the log bucket. What's the recommended flow for short-lived access?

Aisha_security: Use our JIT (just-in-time) access flow — create a time-bound IAM binding (1h) or use short-lived impersonation via an external identity token. Do NOT create permanent viewer bindings. If you need analysts to query data, export redacted logs to BigQuery and grant dataset-level permissions. Also avoid roles/logging.admin for support.

sam_platform: we actually have a helper SA and a policy you can reuse: `redwood-logs-ingest-sa@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/logging.logWriter` on the source project and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the KMS key. In the ingestion project the pipeline SA gets `roles/pubsub.subscriber` + `roles/storage.objectCreator` only.

maria_dev: Can you paste the minimal gcloud binding snippet so I can include it in the infra PR?

sam_platform: sure — minimal example to grant logWriter to a SA at the project level:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-source-project \
  --member=serviceAccount:redwood-logs-ingest-sa@my-source-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/logging.logWriter
```
For the KMS key (encryption by redaction service):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/ingestion-project/locations/global/keyRings/redaction-ring/cryptoKeys/redact-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:redwood-logs-ingest-sa@my-source-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

Aisha_security: Also add a policy note in the PR that any raw prompt fields MUST be processed by the redaction service prior to writing. If a prompt still needs to be available for debugging, store a hashed/TTL-backed copy in an audit-only store and require approval to access.

auditbot: FYI — creating or changing IAM roles on production projects will generate an audit ticket (RDW-4212). Make sure to include the redaction design in the ticket.

maria_dev: Thanks all — I'll update the infra PR with project-scoped writer, KMS binding, and a note about JIT support access. Will link the PR in RDW-4212 when opened. :thumbsup:
